Hello Emma,

Based on your request for a Paris trip on November 15th with a 500 euro budget, I've analyzed the options:

RESTAURANTS:
1. Le Baratin (Rating: 4.8) - Small, cozy bistro with delicious, homestyle cooking, daily changing menu based on fresh market ingredients, natural wine selection, cash only. Price: 30€ per person. Address: 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France.

2. Bistrot Paul Bert (Rating: 4.5) - One of the best classic French bistros in Paris, excellent steak tartare and pommes frites, charming old-school Parisian atmosphere, reservations recommended. Price: 40€ per person. Address: 18 Rue Paul Bert, 75011 Paris, France.

3. Chez L'Ami Jean (Rating: 4.4) - Michelin-starred Basque-influenced cuisine, famous rice pudding dessert, lively, bustling atmosphere, reservations essential. Price: 24€ per person. Address: 27 Rue Malar, 75007 Paris, France.

HOTELS (within budget after accounting for two meals):
1. Le Marais Boutique (Rating: 4.2) - Charming boutique hotel in the heart of Le Marais, beautifully decorated rooms with modern amenities, friendly and attentive staff. Price range: 120-180€ per night.

2. Montmartre Suites (Rating: 4.7) - Luxurious suites with stunning views of Montmartre, impeccable cleanliness and attention to detail, perfect location for exploring Montmartre, in-room breakfast service. Price range: 110-200€ per night.

RECOMMENDATION:
For the top-rated restaurant, I recommend Le Baratin (4.8 rating). For the hotel, Montmartre Suites has the highest rating (4.7) and fits well within your budget when combined with dining costs.
